svg.aria-label: AimDB architecture: inbound connectors (MQTT, KNX, WebSocket, AimDB peers) push into typed records through InboundDispatch; outbound connectors pull from the same record buffers through OutboundRoutes; the aimdb CLI and MCP server reach the records from the top over TCP, Unix socket or serial via one AimX server.
svg.title: AimDB architecture
svg.text: AimX server · one engine for every transport
streams · every reader gets each value
0 allocations per message across this boundary · CI-gated †
Same three buffers on Tokio · Embassy (no_std, Cortex-M) · WASM, checked by one shared conformance suite
hot path · per message · connectors push in and pull out, core runs no tasks in between
request / reply · per request · reads and writes the same records
